fields.people[].id: the internal id where one exists (the casting ids and the routines' ids); id_note says where none was found
fields.people[].name / heard_as: the name in the casting home / what the player hears (Ron, Sheila, 'the new owner' for Tom)
fields.people[].facts[]: kind knows, believes or saw. text is word for word from the home at src (file, line, end) or derived by script from hook-cast.json (derived) or new, marked with a group (new) and a reason (why). secret: held, never told to a stranger. street: the id of a StreetFacts.cs fact. believes carry truth (true, false, unknown, partly) and truth_basis; saw carry when.

fields.people[].newcomer_questions[]: q, a (under 30 words, in their voice), kind (answers, partly, points_to, deflect, dont_know), uses (their own fact ids), bench (the question bench it adapts). Tom has none.
